articles.text: SŪNNǙ: Nǎinai, nín shuō, xīn Zhōngguó, nánnǚ píngděng, fùnǚde dìwèi gāoduō le, duì bu duì?
GRANDDAUGHTER: Grandma, don't you think that in new China, with equality of the sexes, the status of women is much higher?

NǍINAI: Nà hái yòng shuō. Wǒmen niánqīngde shíhou, fùnǚ zài jiāli, zài shèhuìshang dōu méiyou shénme dìwèi, zhǐ yǒu hěn shǎode nǚháizi yǒu jīhui niàn shū. Bú xiàng nǐmen, gēn nánháizi yíyàng, niàn shū, zuò shì, duō hǎo!

GRANDMOTHER: That goes without saying. When we were young, women didn't have much status in the family or in society. Only a very few girls had a chance to study. It wasn't like the way it is for you, who study and work just the same as boys. How great that is!
SŪNNǙ: Nǎinai, nà nǐ shuō, tóngjū zhèijiàn shìr shi bu shi duì fùnǚ bù hǎo?
GRANDDAUGHTER: Then what do you think, Grandma, is cohabitation a bad thing for women?
NǍINAI: Nǐ zěnme yuè shuō yuè qíguài le? Zài xīn Zhōngguó nǎr yǒu tóngjūde shìr?
GRANDMOTHER: What's with these odd topics you're bringing up? Where is there such a thing as cohabitation in new China?
SŪNNǙ: Zěnme méiyou? Wǒ gāngcái kànde Zhōngguó Qīngniánshang jiù yǒu yìpiān wénzhāng, zhèipiān wénzhāng shuō, yǒu yíge nánháizi hé yíge nǚháizi tóngjū le.
GRANDDAUGHTER: There isn't, huh? Well in the China Youth that I just read there's an article that said there was a young man who was living with a young woman.
NǍINAI: Tāmen wèishénme bù jiéhūn?
GRANDMOTHER: Why didn't they get married?
SŪNNǙ: Nèige nánde xiǎng shàng dàxué.
GRANDDAUGHTER: The man wanted to go to college.
NǍINAI: Ou, duì le, jiéle hūn jiù bù néng shàng dàxué le. Nà hòulái ne?
GRANDMOTHER: Oh, right, you can't go to college after you're married. So what happened afterwards?
SŪNNǙ: Hòulái, nèige nánde zhēn shàng dàxué le.
GRANDDAUGHTER: Afterwards, the man really went to college.
NǍINAI: Niànwánle shū tāmen jiéhūn le ba?
GRANDMOTHER: And after he finished school they got married, I suppose?
SŪNNǙ: Méiyou. Niànwán shū, nèige nánde xiǎng, nèi nǚháizi méi dìwèi, yě méi qián, tāmen jiù suàn le.
GRANDDAUGHTER: No. After he finished school, the guy thought, she didn't have any status or any money, so they should call it quits.
NǍINAI: Suàn le?! Wā shi shénme huà! Tā hái yǒu méiyou yìdiǎnr dàodé guānniàn!
GRANDMOTHER: Call it quits! What kind of thing is that to say! Didn't he have any sense of morality!
SŪNNǙ: Dàodé guānniàn?! Hài, xiànzài shèhuìshang jiù yǒu zhèizhǒng shìr! Nín shuō zhèi shi wèishénme?
GRANDDAUGHTER: Sense of morality?! Ha, that's just the sort of thing that society is full of these days! Why do you think that is?!
NǍINAI: Āi! Zhèi shíjǐnián qíqíguàiguàide xīnwén zhēn duō! Shénme shíhou cái néng hǎo yìdiǎnr ne?
GRANDMOTHER: (Sigh) The last decade or so there sure has been a lot of strange news! When will it get better?
SŪNNǙ: Shéi zhīdào! Wǒ xiǎng kuài le! Kuài hǎo yìdiǎnr le!
GRANDDAUGHTER: Who knows! I think it will be soon! It's going to get better soon!
